W-What the heck is this...
Is that some kind of dragon?
Looks like it's a Demi Machina made of a dragon...\nIt's horrible...
...Looks like the people of Lufenas Family are\nconfined in that room.
We need to get rid of it to release them...
Lepage, watch out!!
Let go of it and run!!
No! It's too late!!
I'm sorry...
Finally you became honest with yourself.\nYou gave us a lot of trouble.
S-Shut up! I'm always honest!!
Silence, everyone. Ms. Triet Lufenas the deputy\nhead of Lufenas family comes here.
Whoa?! You're...
Triel!!
Oh, you are...
I didn't expect that you would find out who I am\nlike this.
Triel is my false name...\nMy true name is Triet Lufenas...
Whoa... I knew you had your own reasons since when\nwe met for the first time but I couldn't foresee\nthis.
The Lufenas family head, my dad has been sick\nsince a short while ago, so I came back from\ntravel to work as the deputy but...
Lyark army charged into here and we were confined.
That was tough.\nWell, we have a lot of questions.
You wanna ask many things, right?\nWhy not ask her questions?
Why were you traveling?
Balft isn't your real brother?
Why is your mansion in the empire?
I have no questions.
To look for my brother... The next family head is\nsupposed to be my brother but he's missing after\nhe set out on a journey...
Balft said I shouldn't go alone.\nAnd he accompanied me as my brother.
Well, yea... He didn't look like an elf...
What, really?! We were hiding our social status to\nescape from the assassins who try to ruin Lufenas\nfamily...
W-Well... I guess it didn't work.\nBut Balft must have protected you from them so\nyou won't notice.
...No. I heard that my dad brought him to our\nhouse when he was orphaned during a war.
But he grew up with us since when we were young,\nso he's like a real brother to me...
Now I understand...
Balft is good at both studies and martial arts,\nso my dad was going to adopt him but...
He said he shouldn't rely on my dad since\nhe's not an elf. Then, he left the house and\nvolunteered for the black knights of Lyark.
Oh, that makes sense.\nWe saw Balft and knew he was a black knight\nbefore we came to here...
But there's one thing I don't understand...\nWhy did he volunteered for the black knights...\nThe empire of Lyark is hostile to us...
Of course, he wanted to protect your family.\nHe can get information about Lyark in the army.
You know, the armor of the black knights has\nprotected you.\nYou must be thankful to him, right?
Lufenas family is descended from the royal family\nof Darkan and this mansion used to be near the\nEldenbaum but...
It could be the irony of fate.\nThe mansion was left at the center of the empire\nbecause of the cataclysm.
What?! It's malice rather than irony!
Our ancestors were forced to yield to Lyark\nTechnista again and again but...
They stuck to be in Resistle faction.\nAnd that's why we are supporting the partisan to\nfight against Lyark...
By the way, what if they find out you are\nsupporting the partisans?
She's right. We are grateful for your support but\nthings like this could happen again. You should\nsuspend all supports for a while...
No worries.\nAs I said, Lufenas family is descended from the\nroyal family of Darkan, so
This land is recognized as the place of\nextraterritoriality even outside the empire.\nIf the invasion is revealed to the public...
I got it! They will make enemies of Resistle\nfaction, and Fixion faction that is watching\nthe circumstances!
We will not announce the invasion in public.
They should worry about when we will expose the\nfact...
Even if they knew we are supporting the partisan,\nthey can't deal with it easily.
Triet, you're so smart...
You've thought that far! Amazing!\nHail to Ms. Triet! Hail to Lufenas family!!
I've already seen your strength in a lot of\nevents.\nPlease help out the partisan.
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go out!
